notes.title: Closed beta patch: Crystal Comet 0.96.26.23:
notes.notes:
Crystal Comet 0.96.26.23:

FUN STUFF:
- Added steam achievements to the game.
- Added a shader to bosses to show what phase they are in as players requested health bars but I like the old school super metroid style of showing boss phases. Although it's a bit different to that.
- Added menu item for true last boss to main menu although this will not be visible until unlocked and will not be selectable until the true last boss is added to the game (current working on it).

THE WORST KIND OF BUGS:
- Fixed error caused by last update which caused a crash (occasionally) when an AI team mate drops a power up for you. Was fixed & added in a shadow patch shortly after it was discovered after the last patch.

ANNOYING BUGS:
- Fixed issue related to music not being played in main menu after adjusting the music level briefly introduced since last patch..
- Fixed an issue where full-screen was running in windowed mode sometimes if the player had another application open as game loaded.

NEXT WEEK ON OH MY GOD THIS WILL NEVER END:
- Try and finish the "true last boss". I'm not sure if 3 weeks is actually enough time but will have to see what happens.

notes.title: Crystal Comet 0.96.26.16 update.
notes.notes:
Crystal Comet 0.96.26.16:

FUN STUFF:
- Made menu more explosive: Added rumble to the explosions when selecting certain options.
- Replaced a mouth sound effect that was used as a placeholder *cough*. It was the spinning sound of the frozen Valkyrie's spear.

ACESSIBILITY THINGS:
- Created option to turn down / increase volume of dialogue.
- Added option to turn gamepad rumble on / off for xbox pads (other pads may or may not rumble depending on make).

ADJUSTMENTS:
- Adjusted spacing for Minime powerup and decoys as some players found it hard to tell whether they were shooting when they fly close to an allied players ship.
- Adjusted start volume of game as streamers were turning it down so that it is initially lower. You may need to go into options and adjust dialogue volume accordingly if you are in the closed beta.

ANNOYING BUGS:
- Fixed minor bug where when quit game prompt was active and selecting "no" to quit it would activate whatever menu item was currently highlighted by the menu selector.
- Fixed an issue where sometimes (rarely) pads would rumble and not stop.
- Fixed issue where mini-me powerup would jiggle when in position near a players/allies ship. 
- Fixed issue where allied AI were sometimes not dropping powerups for players when a player did not have one.
- Fixed layering issue related to bandit boss and mini-boss drawing at incorrect depths.
- Fixed bug where level ambience background music was being treated as SFX voume and would play at the incorrect vaules - Audio bugs are literally the worst.
- Fixed issue where correct achievement icons (based on achievement type) where not being drawn via in game achievement system and was just drawing a default icon.

NEXT WEEK ON LET'S GET THIS GAME DONE & STOP MESSING AROUND:
- Add steam achievements to in game achievement system...
- Start work on true last boss.

notes.title: Crystal Comet 0.96.26.11: Closed beta weekly update patch.
notes.notes:
Crystal Comet 0.96.26.11:

FUN STUFF:

 Made mine boss more fun xD. Now it fires more projectiles. Yay.
 Changed main menu when 'first' ever loading the game as I feel this tells a better story. Will not appear if have already beaten the game.


ANNOYING BUGS AND STUFF:

 Made it so that P1 HuD location in game is top left, P2 location is top right, P3 is bottom left etc as this was highly requested.
 Fixed minor bug with robot boss related to enemy spawners entering destroyed state when not supposed to. You're in trouble now... Ahh it's not that bad. Promise...
 Fixed minor bug where bone boss would go too far off-screen.
 Fixed a bug where magic boss would go too far off-screen, which I thought was already fixed. Still needs some work but will get back to it.
 Fixed minor bug where bone mini-boss would go too far off-screen. Think I'm starting to notice a pattern here..
 Fixed minor bug where screen displays in random mode menu where not displaying certain players choices of character in 2-4 player modes.
 Fixed a bug where backing out of the "launching" display during random mode would cause the AI not to select a character.
 Fixed an issue where setting a button input to "Press left stick" or "Press right stick" would cause the text to run past the menu. It now displays "L3" or "R3" respectively.
 Changed the way dropping in and dropping out works slightly. It wasn't really a bug but I changed menu items to use state machines as opposed to just if statements which solved various issues but remembering them all might be a problem..
 Fixed optimisation by 0.001%. Just kidding, I don't how much by.


THE WORST KIND OF BUGS:

 Fixed bug which causes a crash when a controller is disconnected... Don't need that in local co-op games now do we? Thanks to csh_picone for finding that one 8).
 Fixed bug where crash occurred when backing out of countdown when in random mode after selecting characters in multiplayer. Thanks again picone. xD.


NEXT WEEK ON REWDAN HATES BUGS:

 Fix some more minor issues with remapping controls, such as multi-key assignment. Remind me to never code my own controller remapping scheme ever again.
 Add steam achievements and tie to in game achievement system... One day.


PS: If you have any problems with the current closed beta build please reach out to me. Thank you.

notes.title: WARNING WARNING. emergency patch incoming! Crystal Comet: v0.96.26.04.
notes.notes:
Crystal Comet 0.96.26.04:

FUN STUFF:
- Add a new phase to the eyeball boss. Eye'ight? 
- Decided to leave robot boss alone for now as players seem to like that one: "if it ain't broke, don't fix it". Although may come back to that one as noticed a couple of issues on my end.

ANNOYING BUGS AND STUFF:
- Fixed a bug where setting "Fire front guns" via controller remapping to left mouse button would make it so that keyboard could use any key to fire front guns as well... Sigh. Thus causing a kind of "auto fire" situation...
- Wrote a bunch of de-bug code which then had to be de-bugged.
- Checked assigning other actions to left mouse button does not cause similar issues. If you have any problems please let me know!
- Fixed issue where changing fire top guns to right trigger would tie it to the warp as well.

THE WORST KIND OF BUGS:
- Fixed a bug related to mouse cursor causing game to crash on death (thanks VanAlphen for finding that!). 

THIS WEEK ON REWDAN SCREWS UP GAME DEV:
- Still working on some issues related to mouse and keyboard / controller rebindings. There may be some issues as I fix and change things around.
- I have plans to add more fun stuff but bugs need to be DESTROYED.

notes.title: Weekly update: Crystal Comet 0.96.25.99. (Closed Beta).
notes.notes:
Crystal Comet 0.96.25.99:

FUN STUFF:
- Fixed Amber's special ability in final battle. Good luck.
- Made explosive shot powerup more fun.
- Made bone shot powerup... Longer.
- Made dragon shot powerup viable.
- Added ability to take screen shots for steam using f12.
- Added "Thank you for playing!" to end of credits. 

ANNOYING BUGS AND STUFF:
- Fixed bug where if auto target was enabled using mouse and keyboard controls (by setting fire top gun action to any keyboard button instead of the mouse) the player would get unlimited ammo whilst using the missile launcher..
- Updated text which said "FIRE TOP GUNS" to "FIRE TOP GUN" when in the rebinding controls menu.
- Renamed achievement from "I only need one credit" to "We only need one credit".
- Fixed a bug where custom control schemes were not being loaded when dropping into a game and the player assumes control of a character and the defaults were being loaded instead.
- Fixed a bug where custom control schemes were not being loaded in the final battle.
- Fixed a bug where auto target does not work when switching from mouse button press to keyboard button press using custom controls in final battle.
- Fixed an issue where custom control schemes were not loading for player ships etc during final battle.
- Fixed an issue where using auto target via setting custom control scheme to not be mouse controls or right stick controls was not working in final battle.
- Added an 'additional' cross hair target when using mouse and keyboard controls so players know top gun controls are tied to the mouse cursor position. It looks way cooler now 8). You may have to adjust mouse sensitivity if controls don't feel right. If that's not good enough contact me and I will look into improving it even further. Cheers!
- Made Magic boss not trap Ally AI teammates in corners... As much.

NEXT WEEK ON REWDAN SCREWS UP GAME DEV:
- I will be working on fixing controller/keyboard remapping if you are currently experiencing issues set it to "default". Also report in for duty with any bugs to me. Cheers.
- I'd like to add steam achievements at some point this year. The year's nearly over so don't @ me.
- I'd like to make the mine boss more... You'll see.
- Same with the Robot boss.
